name: Snap Supplements
description: US supplement brand founded by three immigrant founders selling clean-label, sugar-free herbal formulas for specific health concerns (prostate, nitric oxide, hormone support), which scaled to a top-10 supplement seller on TikTok Shop through creator affiliates before expanding into major retail chains.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program directory lists Snap Supplements' affiliate program on ShareASale at 16% commission per sale with a 14-day cookie and a $50 payout threshold.

ECRM's Founders' Innovation Day panel write-up quotes co-founder Alex Lomov: Snap generated over $50 million in sales on TikTok Shop by mobilizing an army of creator affiliates publishing thousands of videos every month, and remains a top-10 (often top-5) supplement seller on the platform.

Snap Supplements' own job posting for a TikTok Shop Affiliate Coordinator (Vancouver, WA) describes recruiting, developing and managing a portfolio of top-performing TikTok Shop creators, including samples, commissions and deliverables — evidence of a large, staffed creator affiliate operation.

opportunity.title: Snap Supplements Affiliate Program (ShareASale + TikTok Shop)

reasons.niche_fit: Supplements built for TikTok Shop creator selling — prostate, nitric oxide and hormone formulas are exactly the demo-driven products wellness creators post about.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The strongest UGC evidence in this batch: the co-founder publicly credits thousands of creator affiliate videos a month and $50M+ in TikTok Shop sales, and the brand employs dedicated TikTok Shop affiliate coordinators.
reasons.compensation: A published 16% per-sale rate on ShareASale per the network directory; TikTok Shop rates are set per product and not published on a fetched page.
reasons.contact_access: No public program email or application page was found on a fetched page; joining runs through ShareASale or TikTok Shop, so contact access is mid-band.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open on two fronts — the ShareASale program and TikTok Shop's open affiliate marketplace, where the brand actively recruits creators.
reasons.credibility: Eight-year-old brand, top-10 TikTok Shop supplement seller expanding into major retail chains, per trade-press coverage.

name: Raw Rev
description: US snack brand founded by a registered nurse, mom and chef selling vegan, gluten-free, low-sugar plant-based protein bars (Glo and classic lines) direct to consumers and through retailers.

evidence.summary: Raw Rev's own Awin merchant profile states the program pays 20% commission on every sale with a 30-day cookie, a $70+ average order value, exclusive creator gifting campaigns, custom UTM links and codes, and creative assets; allowed publishers explicitly include influencers, content creators and social media affiliates.

reasons.niche_fit: Clean-label protein bars sit squarely in the healthy-snack content niche — gym bags, desk snacks and vegan haul videos.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile runs explicit creator gifting campaigns and supplies lifestyle images, product shots and swipe copy to creators.
reasons.compensation: A single, clearly published rate — 20% on every sale — stated on the network's own merchant profile, with no conflicting figure found.
reasons.contact_access: Public Awin application route with dedicated program support promised in the profile; no direct program email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open on Awin and creators/influencers are an explicitly allowed publisher type.
reasons.credibility: 20+ year-old brand with national distribution and a long retail track record.

name: FlavCity
description: Food and supplement brand from creator Bobby Parrish (DTBE dba FlavCity) selling clean-ingredient protein shakes, electrolytes and supplements through its own store, TikTok Shop and grocery retailers, built on his 'Bobby Approved' grocery-content audience.

evidence.summary: FlavCity's own site publishes full terms for the 'DTBE dba FlavCity Open Affiliate Program' for TikTok Shop Creators: an open program joined by clicking 'Add Products', paying commission income through TikTok Shop, with detailed advertising guidelines for creators. No percentage is stated in the terms — TikTok Shop rates are set per product inside TikTok Shop.
FlavCity's official FAQ page directs collaboration and partnership requests to partnerships@shopflavcity.com.

reasons.niche_fit: A creator-founded food brand whose protein shakes are sold primarily through short-form grocery and recipe content — a near-perfect UGC fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a formal open affiliate program for TikTok Shop creators with published creator terms and advertising guidelines on its own site.
reasons.compensation: Commission is real and paid through TikTok Shop, but the brand publishes no rate in its terms (rates are set per product in TikTok Shop), so no figure is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: A published partnerships email on the brand's own FAQ page plus the open TikTok Shop route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: An explicitly 'Open' affiliate program — any TikTok Shop creator can add products and start earning.
reasons.credibility: Large, established creator-led brand with national grocery distribution.

name: Primal Queen
description: Women's supplement brand launched in 2024 selling a freeze-dried beef organ superfood (liver, heart, kidney, ovary, uterus, fallopian tubes) formulated for women, plus Goddess Creatine Bites, through its own site and 900+ Target stores.

evidence.summary: Primal Queen's own site hosts a 'Join Primal Queen Affiliate Team' page for its Affiliate Brand Ambassador Program.

A screenshot of Primal Queen's own welcome email to a new Affiliate Brand Ambassador shows a personal discount link giving followers 10% off and paying the ambassador a flat $15 per first purchase, with SEO/paid ads prohibited.

A December 2024 creator recruiting video describes a much richer offer — 100% commission on first-time orders and 25% for life on recurring orders, free starter kit, 1,000-follower minimum — which conflicts with the flat $15 first-purchase figure in the brand's 2026 welcome email, so no rate is recorded.

An affiliate's product link on the brand's own domain carries a Social Snowball tracking parameter (primalqueen.com/pages/goddess?snowball=...), indicating the ambassador program runs on Social Snowball.

opportunity.title: Primal Queen Affiliate Brand Ambassador Program

reasons.niche_fit: A supplement formulated specifically for women, sold almost entirely through female creator testimonials — a strong women's-wellness UGC fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A standing ambassador program with personal links, brand assets, starter kits and constant creator onboarding visible across social platforms.
reasons.compensation: Pay exists but the two documented figures conflict — a flat $15 per first purchase in the brand's welcome email vs a 100% first-order claim in a 2024 recruiting video — so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A public join page on the brand's own site; no program email published on a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open via the join page; a 1,000-follower minimum was reported in recruiting material.
reasons.credibility: Bootstrapped brand reporting $300M lifetime sales in under 30 months and a 900-store Target launch, per trade coverage.

name: mindbodygreen
description: Wellness media company (founded 2009) that also sells its own science-backed supplements and personal care line — sleep, gut health, healthy aging and beauty formulas — through shop.mindbodygreen.com, alongside online classes and health-coaching certification.

evidence.summary: mindbodygreen's own shop runs an affiliate program page with an application form: affiliates get a custom link, earn commission on each sale, and earn free products after just 10 sales; the page targets wellness experts, healthcare providers and health-forward influencers.

mindbodygreen's own 'Become an Affiliate' page states 20% commission on supplements and personal care (average order value $70+), 30% on health coaching and 20% on classes all-access for its #mbgambassador program.
Lasso's directory lists the mindbodygreen program at only 5% per sale, which conflicts with the 20% supplements figure on the brand's own affiliate page, so no single rate is recorded.
Rateful's TikTok Shop analysis estimates about 67% of mindbodygreen shop's TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs.

reasons.niche_fit: A wellness publisher selling its own supplements — its entire business is expert and creator content, so affiliate products slot straight into that content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named ambassador program (#mbgambassador) with community events, free-product milestones, and roughly two-thirds of its TikTok Shop sales attributed to affiliate creators.
reasons.compensation: The brand's own page publishes 20% on supplements, but a network directory lists 5% — the conflict means no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A public application form on the brand's own shop domain; no program email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open to wellness experts, providers and influencers via a short intake form.
reasons.credibility: One of the largest US wellness media brands, operating since 2009 with GMP-certified US manufacturing.

name: Raw Nutrition
description: US sports-nutrition brand co-founded by bodybuilder Chris Bumstead selling pre-workout, protein, creatine and the BUM energy drink line direct to consumers and through major supplement retailers.

evidence.summary: A screenshot of Raw Nutrition's own approval email for its 'Team Thavage' ambassador program directs new affiliates to register, choose a discount code via teamthavage@getrawnutrition.com, and log into a member portal with a tier system.
Lasso's directory lists the Raw Nutrition affiliate program at 15% per sale.

Shopper.com lists the same program at only 2% per sale, and creators who have been in the program publicly describe a 5% starting tier rising to 8% then 10% — three conflicting pictures, so no rate is recorded.

reasons.niche_fit: Pre-workout, protein and energy drinks from a five-time Mr. Olympia's brand — core fitness-creator products with a built-in athlete story.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured ambassador team (Team Thavage) with personal codes, a member portal and tier progression, documented in the brand's own onboarding emails.
reasons.compensation: Sources conflict sharply — 15% (Lasso), 2% (Shopper) and creator-reported 5/8/10% tiers — so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A published program team email, teamthavage@getrawnutrition.com, from the brand's own onboarding email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The ambassador team recruits publicly through the brand's social channels, though no open application page was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: One of the fastest-growing US supplement brands with national retail distribution and a celebrity-athlete co-founder.

name: Kion
description: Boulder, Colorado supplement brand founded by former pro athlete Ben Greenfield selling clean, third-party-tested daily formulas — Kion Aminos, protein, creatine, colostrum and coffee — for energy, lean muscle and longevity.

evidence.summary: Kion's own site hosts a dedicated affiliate landing page ('Affiliate LP', getkion.com/pages/affiliate-lp) used to recruit affiliates; the campaign parameters on the page show the program is managed through Aspire. The page publishes no commission rate or cap.

The same official page describes Kion as Boulder, Colorado-based, selling research-backed, third-party-tested supplements with a 60-day money-back guarantee, and lists phone contact 855-387-KION (5466).

reasons.niche_fit: Clean longevity and performance supplements are a staple of the biohacking and fitness-creator niche Kion was built in.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand recruits affiliates through dedicated landing pages and influencer campaigns run on Aspire, though it publishes little public program detail.
reasons.compensation: A real program exists, but Kion publishes no rate or terms on its public pages, so nothing is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate landing page on the brand's own domain; the contact email on the page is obfuscated, so no email is recorded.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Affiliate recruitment is live via the brand's landing page and Aspire campaigns, but application is campaign-based rather than a standing open form.
reasons.credibility: Established premium supplement brand with third-party testing, NSF-certified cGMP facilities and a well-known founder.

name: Obvi
description: US wellness brand selling flavored collagen peptides, collagen protein, greens and burn/weight-management supplements aimed at women, sold through its own store and Amazon.

evidence.summary: Obvi's own terms of service contain a detailed Affiliate Program section — assigned tracking links, traffic-source disclosure, paid-advertising restrictions and commission withholding rules — confirming a standing affiliate program on myobvi.com.
Obvi's own published affiliate playbook says smaller influencers start at 30% commission and larger influencers get 50%, run through Social Snowball with unique discount-code links for each creator.

Obvi's official Instagram recruiting post offers affiliates 25% commission on referrals plus free products and early access — a third, different figure alongside the playbook's 30%/50% and Shopper.com's 10%, so no rate is recorded.

reasons.niche_fit: Flavored collagen and women's wellness supplements are heavily promoted through short-form creator content, Obvi's home turf.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand publicly runs two affiliate tracks — customers and creators — with per-creator codes and links, and recruits ambassadors on its own Instagram.
reasons.compensation: Published figures conflict across the brand's own materials (25% on Instagram, 30%/50% tiers in its playbook, 10% on Shopper), so no rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: No public program email or application page was found on a fetched page; entry is via the brand's social recruiting and Social Snowball.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Recruiting is public and ongoing on the brand's own channels, aimed at smaller creators as well as large influencers.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC collagen brand, though its aggressive recruiting attracts mixed public sentiment.

name: Natural Stacks
description: US nootropics brand founded in 2013 billing itself as the world's first open-source supplement company, selling transparent-label brain and mood formulas (NeuroFuel, MagTech, Smart Caffeine) direct to consumers.

evidence.summary: Natural Stacks' official site runs an Affiliate Program page describing a tiered commission system with performance incentives, monthly payments with absolutely no minimum, a dedicated affiliate manager with email support, and an Apply Here route.

Wootfi's program listing says Natural Stacks tracks through Refersion with a 180-day cookie, a $50 minimum payout via PayPal, a 25% base commission, and gives the program contact as affiliate@naturalstacks.com.
Lasso lists the program at 15% per sale with a 30-day cookie, and other directories cite 20% and up to 30% — figures conflict across every source (15/20/25/30%), so no rate is recorded.

reasons.niche_fit: Nootropics and focus supplements are a dedicated creator niche (biohacking, study and productivity content) that Natural Stacks helped define.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate program with a dedicated affiliate manager and custom creative support, though it is publisher/blog-led more than short-form-creator-led.
reasons.compensation: Every source disagrees — 15%, 20%, 25% and up to 30% all appear — so no rate is recorded and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: A published program email, affiliate@naturalstacks.com, plus an application page on the brand's official site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open via the official affiliate page; some listings report a 5,000-follower/subscriber eligibility bar.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2013 with a distinctive open-source-label reputation in the nootropics category.

name: RAW Nutritional
description: Canadian vegan supplement brand founded in 2017 selling organic plant-based protein, greens and superfood products that are soy-free and eco-packaged, shipped across Canada and the United States.

evidence.summary: RAW Nutritional's own affiliate page invites influencers, bloggers and coupon sites into a 'competitive, profitable tiered commission structure' with an average order size of $100, a 24-hour tracking platform, banners and free-gift consumer incentives; signup runs through Affiliatly and is open to residents of Canada and the US with a health, fitness or veganism audience. No numeric rate is published.

reasons.niche_fit: Vegan protein and superfoods fit the plant-based fitness niche well, though the brand is Canada-first and smaller than US rivals.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open affiliate page explicitly recruiting influencers with tracking, banners and consumer gift incentives, but little public creator-program detail beyond that.
reasons.compensation: The brand confirms a tiered commission structure but publishes no numbers, so no rate is recorded.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate page with signup on the brand's own domain; no program email published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open to Canada/US creators with a health, fitness or vegan audience.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2017 with a clear niche identity, but modest scale and visibility outside Canada.
